name: ALEPH: Alliance for Jewish Renewal
reason: Fewer than about 3 evergreen videos in the last two years: recent uploads are almost all promo reels and clips under 2 minutes; the only longer ones are a 2.5-hour panel, a fundraising cabaret and a staff introduction (YouTube Data API, 10 Nov 2026; 379 subscribers). The organisation itself (aleph.org) could be a future Organisation lead.
